definitionZh: 动画范围CSS的短手属性用于设定动画附件范围的起始和结尾沿其时间段,即动画沿时间段开始和结束的位置.
sourceDefinition: The animation-range CSS shorthand property is used to set the start and end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e., where along the timeline an animation will start and end.
